status: Analytical load screen only; no measured mass, vibration, acceleration or bearing suitability

evidence.density: 1.22 g/cm3 published PCCF density. CAD solid volume assumes solid printed material; real mass must be weighed.
evidence.bearing: NSK695ZZ1 approximate total mass2.5 g. Each planet carries two. Supplier catalog asks for consultation when shielded bearings have rotating outer rings; generic limiting RPM is not application approval.
evidence.metal_density: Steel7.85 and brass8.5 g/cm3 are engineering assumptions. Geometry-based hardware masses ignore some reliefs and socket holes.
evidence.mass_multiplier: 1.25 is an engineering sensitivity allowance, not a measured or certified upper bound.
evidence.no_load: No-load motor RPM scales linearly with supply voltage for an illustrative case. Controller limits, back-driving, losses and actual maximum RPM are unverified.
